# AuthCost — full ledger

## Calculator
Interactive MAU / MFA / SSO cost ranking: https://authcost.pages.dev/calculator/?mau=50000&sso=5&mfa=0
Share via query params: mau, sso, org (organizations / tenants, default 0 = B2C; each SSO connection counts as at least 1), mpo (members per organization, default = fpc), mfa (0|1), fpc (SSO users per connection for per-SSO-user vendors, default 200), vo (verified-only 0|1), embed=1 for chrome-free iframe.
Embed: <iframe src="https://authcost.pages.dev/calculator/?embed=1&mau=50000&sso=5" title="AuthCost calculator" width="100%" height="720" loading="lazy"></iframe>

25 plans, 25 verified, 10 vendors. Checked through 2026-10-31.

## Vendors
### Clerk
- id: clerk
- source: https://clerk.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MRU
- summary: Hobby free to 50k MRU/app. Pro $25/mo ($20 annual) with 50k MRU + 1 SSO + 1 Directory Sync. Extra SSO $75 (2–15) then $60 (16–100) and $48 (101–250). Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01.

### Auth0
- id: auth0
- source: https://auth0.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free to 25k MAU with 1 Enterprise Connection, Self-Service SSO and inbound SCIM. B2C Essentials runs $35 (500 MAU) → $700 (10k) → $3,500 (50k)/mo; B2C Professional $240 → $1,600 (10k) → $3,200 (20k). B2B Essentials $150 (500) → $2,100 (10k) → $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections; B2B Professional $800 → $2,400 (10k) with 5. Extra SSO connections $100/mo. Yearly = 11× monthly. Above those tiers: Enterprise, contact sales.

### Amazon Cognito
- id: cognito
- source: https://aws.amazon.com/cognito/pricing/
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU
- summary: Essentials (default) free 10k MAU then $0.015/MAU (direct/social). Lite free 10k then $0.0055 / $0.0046 bands. Plus $0.020/MAU no free tier. Federated SAML/OIDC: 50 free then $0.015/MAU.

### WorkOS
- id: workos
- source: https://workos.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU + connection
- summary: AuthKit free to 1M MAU then $2,500/mo per additional 1M. SSO and Directory Sync each: $125 (1–15), $100 (16–30), $80 (31–50), $65 (51–100).

### Stytch
- id: stytch
- source: https://stytch.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU + connection
- summary: B2B pay-as-you-go: $0 base, 10k MAU + 5 SSO/SCIM included, then $125 per additional connection. Custom brand $99. MAU overage rate not published as a fixed figure on the checked page.

### Logto
- id: logto
- source: https://logto.io/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: token + add-on
- summary: Free: 50k MAU / 50k tokens. Pro from $24/mo: unlimited MAU, 50k tokens then $0.08 per 100 extra. Enterprise SSO add-on $48/connector. MFA add-on $48. Organizations add-on $48.

### Kinde
- id: kinde
- source: https://kinde.com/pricing/
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free $0 / Pro $25 / Plus $75 / Scale $250. Each includes 10,500 MAU; Pro overage $0.0175/MAU. Plus and Scale include unlimited enterprise SSO at no per-connection fee. Free/Pro include 1 SSO connection.

### Supabase Auth
- id: supabase
- source: https://supabase.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free: 50k MAU. Pro from $25/mo: 100k MAU then $0.00325/MAU. SAML SSO: 50 included then $0.015/MAU. Auth-only cost is entangled with the platform plan.

### Firebase Auth / Identity Platform
- id: firebase
- source: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU
- summary: No cost up to 50k MAU (email, phone, anonymous, social), then $0.0055/MAU to 100k, $0.0046 to 1M, $0.0032 to 10M, $0.0025 above. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. SMS (phone sign-in and MFA) billed per message by region (US $0.01); first 10 SMS a day not billed. Sources: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing.

### Descope
- id: descope
- source: https://www.descope.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-31
- unit: MAU + tenant
- summary: Free Forever $0: 7,500 MAU, 10 tenants, 3 SSO connections, no overages. Pro starts at $249/mo billed annually: 10,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 35 tenants then $1, 5 SSO then $50/connection. Growth starts at $799/mo: 25,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 100 tenants, 10 SSO then $50, SCIM. Enterprise: contact sales.

## B2B organizations / tenants
SSO results assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members per org = SSO users per connection, default 200). Clerk: 100 retained orgs and 20 members per org free, then the B2B Authentication add-on at $100/mo ($85 billed annually) plus $1→$0.60 per extra org; Auth0: Free 5 and B2C plans 10 organizations, B2B plans unlimited; Descope: 10 / 35 / 100 active tenants, then $1 per tenant on Pro and Growth (Free has no overage); Kinde: 5 orgs on Free, 50 included on paid plans then $0.50→$0.43 per org; Logto: Organizations add-on $48/mo. Plans over a published cap are excluded. Yes for Clerk, Auth0, Descope, Kinde and Logto. At 10k users with 1 SSO customer (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection, 200 members), Clerk Pro is $125/mo because more than 20 members per org needs the B2B Authentication add-on ($100/mo); with 20 or fewer members it is $25/mo. Auth0 Free lists $0 but caps at 5 organizations. At 10k users and 150 organizations (no SSO): Clerk Pro $175/mo (incl. $150 org fees), Descope Pro $364/mo (incl. $115), Kinde Pro $75/mo (incl. $50); Auth0 Free and B2C plans are out (5 and 10-org caps). Details: https://authcost.pages.dev/methodology#b2b-orgs

## Auth0 for Startups (promotion, not used in rankings)
Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31) gives eligible startups one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU, with 5 Enterprise Connections, Enterprise MFA and inbound SCIM. Eligibility (Auth0’s words): venture-backed with less than $5M in funding; less than $1M in annual recurring revenue; less than two years from the date of incorporation; not valid for existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past program members. When the 12 months end, list price applies: B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections is $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500/mo at 5,000 MAU, $2,400/mo at 10,000 MAU; above 10,000 MAU Auth0 publishes no B2B Professional price (contact sales). Not eligible? Nothing changes: list prices apply from month 1. Our rankings always use list prices. Source: https://auth0.com/startups (read 2026-10-31).

## Self-hosting (Better Auth / Auth.js)
Open-source libraries (Better Auth MIT, Auth.js ISC; Auth.js is now part of Better Auth) have no per-user fee. Costs instead: transactional email (Amazon SES $0.10/1,000 outbound), SMS (Identity Platform US $0.01/SMS reference), database/hosting and engineer hours (user-supplied assumptions). Optional Better Auth managed infrastructure: Pro $20/mo, SSO 1 connection then $50/mo each, email $0.001, SMS $0.09 (better-auth.com/pricing, checked 2026-10-31). Break-even math vs Clerk/Auth0/Firebase at 10k/50k/100k: https://authcost.pages.dev/guides/self-hosted-auth-cost

## Changes
- 2027-01-01 Clerk (fee-start): Clerk Directory Sync connection billing starts 2027-01-01 (same ladder as SSO: 1 included on Pro/Business, then $75 / $60 bands). Announced on clerk.com/pricing. [https://clerk.com/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 Auth0 (coverage-added): Added Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31): eligible startups (venture-backed with less than $5M in funding, less than $1M ARR, less than two years from incorporation; not existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past members) get one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU with 5 Enterprise Connections and inbound SCIM. Shown as a note on the SSO guide, Auth0 vendor page and every Auth0 comparison with the month-13 list price (B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections: $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500 at 5,000, $2,400 at 10,000; above 10,000 MAU contact sales). Rankings still use list prices. [https://auth0.com/startups]
- 2026-10-31 AuthCost (correction): Correction: SSO and B2B answers now include organization/tenant fees and caps read from vendor pages on 2026-10-31. Clerk: 100 monthly retained orgs and 20 members per org free; above either, the B2B Authentication add-on is $100/mo ($85 annual), then $1/mo per org (101–1,000), $0.90 (1,001–10,000), $0.75 (10,001–100,000), $0.60 (100,001+). Auth0: Free 5 and B2C plans 10 organizations; B2B unlimited. Descope: 10/35/100 active tenants, then $1 per tenant on Pro and Growth. Kinde: Free 5 orgs, paid 50 then $0.50/$0.47/$0.43. Logto: Organizations add-on $48/mo. Each SSO connection now counts as 1 customer organization. Before, Clerk vs Auth0 at 10k users with 1 SSO connection read '$300/yr less than Clerk'; it is $1,500/yr (Clerk Pro $125/mo incl. the $100/mo add-on for 200-member orgs). [https://clerk.com/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 AuthCost (coverage-added): Added Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no cost to 50k MAU, then $0.0055→$0.0025/MAU bands; SAML/OIDC $0.015/MAU after 50) and Descope (Free 7.5k MAU; Pro from $249/mo with 10k MAU + $0.05/MAU; Growth from $799/mo with 25k MAU), read from their official pricing pages. New guide: what self-hosting Better Auth / Auth.js costs instead. [https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 Clerk (new-tier): Clerk publishes a new enterprise SSO connection band: connections 101–250 now cost $48/mo each (was "Contact us" for 101+). Earlier bands are unchanged: 1 included, $75/mo each for 2–15, $60/mo each for 16–100; 251+ is contact sales. [https://clerk.com/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 Auth0 (correction): Correction: our earlier Auth0 data (2026-10-30) listed paid tiers only at 500 MAU and called higher volumes and B2B “custom”. That was wrong — Auth0 publishes MAU tiers: B2C Essentials $70 (1k) to $3,500 (50k)/mo, B2C Professional to $3,200 (20k), B2B Essentials $150 (500) to $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections, B2B Professional $800 to $2,400 (10k) with 5. Billing rounds up to the next tier; yearly = 11× monthly; extra SSO connections $100/mo. Not an Auth0 price change — our omission, now fixed. [https://auth0.com/pricing.md]
- 2026-10-30 AuthCost (launch-seed): Initial ledger seeded from official pricing pages (Clerk, Auth0, Cognito, WorkOS, Stytch, Logto, Kinde, Supabase Auth). [https://clerk.com/pricing]
